description: MISRA C:2012 Compliant Code Patterns for foxBMS

categories.name: Pointer Validation Patterns
categories.description: MISRA C:2012 Rules 11.x - Pointer type conversions and validation

patterns.name: Null Pointer Check
patterns.description: Always use explicit NULL comparison for pointer validation
patterns.template: if (ptr != NULL) { /* safe to use ptr */ }
patterns.rationale: Explicit comparison prevents implicit pointer-to-boolean conversion

patterns.name: FAS_ASSERT Pointer Validation
patterns.description: Use FAS_ASSERT for pointer parameter validation
patterns.rationale: FAS_ASSERT provides consistent error handling across foxBMS

patterns.name: Const Pointer Input Parameter
patterns.description: Use const for pointer parameters that are not modified
patterns.template: void Function(const uint8_t* pData, uint32_t length)
patterns.rationale: Const correctness improves code safety and readability

patterns.name: Pointer Arithmetic Bounds Check
patterns.description: Validate pointer arithmetic stays within array bounds

patterns.name: Void Pointer Cast
patterns.description: Avoid casting from void pointer to object pointer
patterns.rationale: Explicit cast documents intentional type conversion

patterns.name: Function Pointer Validation
patterns.description: Validate function pointers before calling
patterns.rationale: Prevents undefined behavior from null function pointers

patterns.name: Pointer Return Value Check
patterns.description: Always check return value of functions returning pointers
patterns.template:
void* pMem = malloc(size);
if (pMem == NULL) { /* handle error */ }
patterns.rationale: Prevents null pointer dereference on allocation failure

patterns.name: Pointer to Integer Cast
patterns.description: Avoid pointer to integer conversions unless necessary for hardware access
patterns.rationale: uintptr_t is guaranteed to hold pointer value

patterns.name: Pointer Array Initialization
patterns.description: Initialize pointer arrays to NULL

patterns.name: Double Pointer Validation
patterns.description: Validate both levels of double pointers
patterns.rationale: Must validate outer pointer before dereferencing

patterns.name: Pointer Comparison Same Array
patterns.description: Only compare pointers within same array
patterns.rationale: Pointer comparison undefined between different arrays

patterns.name: Pointer Subtraction
patterns.description: Only subtract pointers within same array
patterns.template: ptrdiff_t offset = pEnd - pStart; /* same array */
patterns.rationale: Pointer subtraction undefined between different arrays

patterns.name: Const Qualification Preservation
patterns.description: Do not cast away const qualification
patterns.template: const uint8_t* pConstData = pData; /* preserve const */
patterns.rationale: Casting away const can lead to undefined behavior

patterns.name: Pointer to Struct Member
patterns.description: Use structure member access instead of pointer arithmetic
patterns.rationale: Structure member access is type-safe and readable

patterns.name: Output Pointer Parameter
patterns.description: Validate output pointer parameters before use
patterns.rationale: Must validate before writing through pointer

patterns.name: Pointer Increment Bounds
patterns.description: Check bounds before pointer increment
patterns.rationale: Pointer must not exceed array bounds

patterns.name: Flexible Array Member
patterns.description: Avoid flexible array members
patterns.template: typedef struct { uint32_t size; uint8_t data[MAX_SIZE]; } Buffer_s;
patterns.anti_pattern: typedef struct { uint32_t size; uint8_t data[]; } Buffer_s;
patterns.rationale: Flexible array members have undefined size

patterns.name: Pointer Alignment
patterns.description: Ensure proper alignment when casting pointers

patterns.name: Pointer Size Independence
patterns.description: Use size_t for sizes and ptrdiff_t for differences
patterns.template:
size_t bufferSize = sizeof(buffer);
ptrdiff_t offset = pEnd - pStart;

patterns.name: Pointer Initialization at Declaration
patterns.description: Initialize pointers at declaration

categories.name: Range Checking Patterns
categories.description: MISRA C:2012 Rules 10.x, 14.x - Integer overflow and range validation

patterns.name: Integer Overflow Prevention
patterns.description: Check for overflow before arithmetic operation
patterns.rationale: Prevents undefined behavior from integer overflow

patterns.name: Array Index Bounds Check
patterns.description: Validate array index before access

patterns.name: Division by Zero Check
patterns.description: Validate divisor is non-zero before division
patterns.rationale: Division by zero is undefined behavior

patterns.name: Enum Range Validation
patterns.description: Validate enum values before use

patterns.name: Signed to Unsigned Conversion
patterns.description: Validate signed value is non-negative before unsigned conversion
patterns.rationale: Negative to unsigned conversion wraps around

patterns.name: Multiplication Overflow Check
patterns.description: Check for overflow before multiplication

patterns.name: Shift Range Validation
patterns.description: Validate shift amount is within type width
patterns.rationale: Shift by type width or more is undefined

patterns.name: Type Narrowing Check
patterns.description: Validate value fits in narrower type

patterns.name: Parameter Range Assertion
patterns.description: Assert parameter ranges at function entry

patterns.name: Loop Counter Type
patterns.description: Use appropriate type for loop counter
patterns.template: for (uint32_t i = 0u; i < count; i++) { /* body */ }
patterns.anti_pattern: for (int i = 0; i < count; i++) { /* body */ }
patterns.rationale: Match counter type to compared value type

patterns.name: Saturating Addition
patterns.description: Implement saturating arithmetic for safety
patterns.rationale: Saturation prevents overflow in non-critical paths

patterns.name: Percentage Bounds
patterns.description: Validate percentage values are 0-100

patterns.name: Temperature Range Check
patterns.description: Validate temperature within physical limits
patterns.rationale: Temperature outside physical limits indicates sensor error

patterns.name: Voltage Range Check
patterns.description: Validate voltage within operational limits
patterns.rationale: Voltage outside limits indicates measurement error

patterns.name: Current Range Check
patterns.description: Validate current within safe limits
patterns.rationale: Current outside limits may indicate fault

patterns.name: Timestamp Overflow Handling
patterns.description: Handle timer counter overflow correctly
patterns.rationale: Timer counters overflow and wrap around

patterns.name: SOC Range Validation
patterns.description: Validate State of Charge is 0-10000 (0.00%-100.00%)

categories.name: Memory Safety Patterns
categories.description: MISRA C:2012 Rules 17.x, 21.x - Memory allocation and access safety

patterns.name: Static Memory Allocation
patterns.description: Use static allocation instead of dynamic
patterns.rationale: Dynamic allocation in safety-critical systems is prohibited

patterns.name: Stack Array Size Limit
patterns.description: Limit stack-allocated array size
patterns.rationale: Large stack arrays cause stack overflow

patterns.name: Buffer Copy Bounds Check
patterns.description: Validate buffer sizes before copy

patterns.name: String Buffer Overflow Prevention
patterns.description: Use length-limited string functions

patterns.name: Array Initialization
patterns.description: Fully initialize arrays or use designated initializers

patterns.name: Structure Initialization
patterns.description: Initialize all structure members

patterns.name: VLA Prohibition
patterns.description: Do not use variable length arrays

patterns.name: Memory Alignment Check
patterns.description: Ensure proper memory alignment for type

patterns.name: Memset Zero Pattern
patterns.description: Use memset for zero initialization of buffers
patterns.rationale: memset is optimized and clear in intent

patterns.name: Structure Padding Awareness
patterns.description: Order structure members to minimize padding
patterns.template: typedef struct { uint32_t large; uint16_t medium; uint8_t small; } Optimized_s;
patterns.anti_pattern: typedef struct { uint8_t small; uint32_t large; uint16_t medium; } Wasteful_s;

patterns.name: Sizeof on Array Type
patterns.description: Use sizeof with array type for correct size
patterns.rationale: sizeof pointer returns pointer size, not array size

patterns.name: Buffer Overread Prevention
patterns.description: Validate read length against buffer size

patterns.name: Static Buffer for Return
patterns.description: Use static buffer for function returning pointer
patterns.template:
static char buffer[SIZE]; /* persistent across calls */
return buffer;
patterns.anti_pattern:
char buffer[SIZE];
return buffer; /* dangling pointer */
patterns.rationale: Returning pointer to auto variable is undefined

patterns.name: Union Type Safety
patterns.description: Add type tag to union for safe access
patterns.template: typedef struct { DataType_e type; union { int32_t i; float f; } value; } TaggedUnion_s;
patterns.anti_pattern: union { int32_t i; float f; } value;
patterns.rationale: Type tag ensures correct union member access

patterns.name: Circular Buffer Bounds
patterns.description: Use modulo for circular buffer index
patterns.rationale: Modulo ensures index stays within bounds

categories.name: Control Flow Patterns
categories.description: MISRA C:2012 Rules 14.x, 15.x, 16.x - Control flow and decision safety

patterns.name: Switch Default Case
patterns.description: Always include default case in switch
patterns.anti_pattern: switch (value) { case A: break; case B: break; }

patterns.name: Switch Break Statement
patterns.description: Every non-empty case must end with break

patterns.name: Single Entry Single Exit
patterns.description: Function should have single exit point

patterns.name: Loop Counter Modification
patterns.description: Only modify loop counter in for statement
patterns.template: for (uint32_t i = 0u; i < count; i++) { /* no i modification */ }
patterns.anti_pattern: for (uint32_t i = 0u; i < count; i++) { if (cond) { i++; } }
patterns.rationale: Counter modification in loop body is confusing

patterns.name: Boolean Type in Conditions
patterns.description: Use explicit boolean comparison

patterns.name: Compound Condition Parentheses
patterns.description: Use parentheses in compound conditions
patterns.anti_pattern: if (a > b && c < d || e == f) { /* ambiguous */ }

patterns.name: Else After If Block
patterns.description: If-else-if chain must end with else

patterns.name: Goto Prohibition
patterns.description: Do not use goto statement
patterns.rationale: Goto makes control flow difficult to follow

patterns.name: Invariant Loop Condition
patterns.description: Avoid conditions that are always true or false
patterns.template: while (running == true) { /* body may set running = false */ }

patterns.name: Null Statement Clarification
patterns.description: Braces around null statement or comment

patterns.name: Return in Void Function
patterns.description: All non-void functions must return value

patterns.name: Comparison Order
patterns.description: Place constant on right side of comparison

patterns.name: Assignment in Condition
patterns.description: No assignment in conditional expression
patterns.template:
result = Function();
if (result != NULL) { /* use result */ }

patterns.name: Unreachable Code
patterns.description: No unreachable code after return/break

patterns.name: Loop Termination
patterns.description: Ensure loops have well-defined termination
patterns.rationale: Bounded loops are safer than infinite loops

patterns.name: Function Parameter Count
patterns.description: Limit function parameters to manageable number
patterns.template:
typedef struct { Type1 a; Type2 b; Type3 c; } Params_s;
void Function(const Params_s* params);
patterns.anti_pattern: void Function(Type1 a, Type2 b, Type3 c, Type4 d, Type5 e, Type6 f);

categories.name: Type Safety Patterns
categories.description: MISRA C:2012 Rules 10.x - Type conversions and safety

patterns.name: Explicit Type Casting
patterns.description: Use explicit casts for type conversions

patterns.name: Unsigned Integer Literal Suffix
patterns.description: Use u suffix for unsigned literals

patterns.name: Fixed Width Integer Types
patterns.description: Use fixed-width types from stdint.h
patterns.rationale: Fixed-width types have consistent size across platforms

patterns.name: Boolean Type Usage
patterns.description: Use bool type for boolean values

patterns.name: Enum Type Declaration
patterns.description: Define enum with explicit values
patterns.template: typedef enum { STATE_IDLE = 0u, STATE_RUN = 1u, STATE_ERROR = 2u } State_e;
patterns.anti_pattern: typedef enum { STATE_IDLE, STATE_RUN, STATE_ERROR } State_e;

patterns.name: Bitfield Type
patterns.description: Use unsigned type for bit fields
patterns.template: struct { uint32_t flag : 1; uint32_t value : 7; } bitfield;
patterns.anti_pattern: struct { int flag : 1; int value : 7; } bitfield;
patterns.rationale: Signed bit fields have implementation-defined behavior

patterns.name: Char Type for Characters Only
patterns.description: Use char only for characters, uint8_t for bytes

patterns.name: Floating Point Comparison
patterns.description: Use epsilon for floating point comparison
patterns.rationale: Floating point equality is rarely exact

patterns.name: Typedef for Complex Types
patterns.description: Use typedef for function pointer types

patterns.name: Size Type for Sizes
patterns.description: Use size_t for sizes and counts
patterns.rationale: size_t is the standard type for sizes

patterns.name: Bitwise Operation Type
patterns.description: Use unsigned types for bitwise operations
patterns.template:
uint32_t mask = 0x00FFu;
uint32_t result = value & mask;
patterns.rationale: Signed bitwise operations have implementation-defined behavior

patterns.name: Macro Type Safety
patterns.description: Wrap macro parameters in parentheses

patterns.name: Constant Expression Type
patterns.description: Match constant type to variable type

patterns.name: Struct Type Consistency
patterns.description: Use consistent struct tag and typedef naming
patterns.template: typedef struct Data_tag { uint32_t value; } Data_s;

patterns.name: Hexadecimal Literal Format
patterns.description: Use uppercase hex digits with type suffix
patterns.rationale: Uppercase improves readability, suffix clarifies type

patterns.name: Volatile Qualifier Usage
patterns.description: Use volatile for hardware registers
patterns.rationale: Volatile prevents compiler optimization of hardware access

categories.name: Error Handling Patterns
categories.description: MISRA C:2012 Rules 17.x, 21.x - Error detection and handling

patterns.name: Return Value Check
patterns.description: Check return value of all non-void functions
patterns.template:
STD_RETURN_TYPE_e result = Function();
if (result != STD_OK) { /* handle error */ }
patterns.rationale: Ignoring errors leads to silent failures

patterns.name: FAS_ASSERT for Assertions
patterns.description: Use FAS_ASSERT for invariant checks

patterns.name: Error Code Return
patterns.description: Return error codes from functions
patterns.rationale: Error codes allow proper error handling

patterns.name: Diagnostic Reporting
patterns.description: Report errors to diagnostic system

patterns.name: Error Propagation
patterns.description: Propagate errors up the call stack
patterns.template:
result = SubFunction();
if (result != STD_OK) { return result; }

patterns.name: Safe State Transition
patterns.description: Transition to safe state on critical error

patterns.name: Error Recovery Pattern
patterns.description: Implement error recovery with retry

patterns.name: Timeout Error Handling
patterns.description: Handle timeout conditions explicitly

patterns.name: Hardware Error Detection
patterns.description: Check hardware status registers
patterns.rationale: Hardware can fail and must be monitored

patterns.name: Plausibility Check
patterns.description: Validate data plausibility

patterns.name: CRC Validation
patterns.description: Validate CRC on received data

patterns.name: Error Context Logging
patterns.description: Log error context for debugging

categories.name: State Machine Patterns
categories.description: MISRA C:2012 Rules 14.x, 16.x - State machine implementation

patterns.name: State Enum Definition
patterns.description: Define states as enum with explicit values
patterns.anti_pattern: typedef enum { IDLE, RUN, ERROR } State_e;

patterns.name: State Transition Table
patterns.description: Use transition table for valid transitions
patterns.rationale: Table makes transitions explicit and verifiable

patterns.name: State Validation
patterns.description: Validate state values before use
patterns.rationale: State variable may contain invalid value

patterns.name: State Machine Context
patterns.description: Encapsulate state in context structure

patterns.name: State Entry Action
patterns.description: Execute entry actions on state transition

patterns.name: State Exit Action
patterns.description: Execute exit actions before leaving state
patterns.rationale: Exit actions clean up state properly

patterns.name: State Timeout Handling
patterns.description: Implement timeout for state duration

patterns.name: State Machine Reset
patterns.description: Implement state machine reset function
patterns.rationale: Reset enables recovery from error states

patterns.name: State Transition Logging
patterns.description: Log state transitions for debugging
patterns.rationale: Logging helps debug state machine behavior

patterns.name: State Guard Condition
patterns.description: Implement guard conditions for transitions

patterns.name: Hierarchical State Machine
patterns.description: Implement nested state machines
patterns.anti_pattern: /* flat state machine with many states */

patterns.name: State Persistence
patterns.description: Save state for power-cycle recovery

patterns.name: BMS State Machine Pattern
patterns.description: Standard BMS state machine structure

patterns.name: State Machine Trigger
patterns.description: Periodic state machine trigger function

patterns.name: State Machine Request Pattern
patterns.description: Request-based state transition

patterns.name: State Substate Pattern
patterns.description: Sub-state for complex state behavior

usage.how_to_use: Reference patterns by ID when generating code. Apply patterns based on context and MISRA rule requirements.
